title: bell24-diagonal
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset: ONE original Japanese call-center recruitment HERO image, wide landscape aspect about 1938:811 (2.39:1). This is a new site-referenced creative direction, not a website screenshot or a clone.
Input image 1: actual saved website screenshot of ベルシステム24, https://www.bell24.co.jp/. Study its composition, type hierarchy and imagery treatment. Input image 2: our current call-center image, used ONLY for subject context (headsets, operators, call-center equipment), not its repeated anime arrangement.
Observed reference element: 白地に人物の切り抜き、斜めの色面、右寄せの大きなコピー。視線が対角線に流れる構成。
Direction: Use the attached Bell24 screenshot's DIAGONAL composition: white background, two photorealistic Japanese call-center colleagues cut out on the LEFT, wearing real communications headsets, confidently stepping toward a shared workplace with naturally held call-script clipboard. Large restrained navy-blue headline on RIGHT, diagonal pale-blue stripe rising from lower left to upper right beneath them. A small authentic phone/CRM workstation grounds the call-center theme. Soft editorial photography, largely neutral clothing with cobalt details. No copied poses or identities from the source, no jumping stock cartoon. The composition should differ strongly from the old text-left/team-right anime.
Exact ORIGINAL approved copy: small label "CALL CENTER RECRUIT"; headline "声をつなぐ、" / "仲間と進む。"; subcopy "コールセンターで、新しい一歩を。". Use these strings ONLY, plus 電話対応 / 営業 / サポート / チーム if small work labels are needed. Do not copy any text from the attached website screenshot.
Keep call-center theme recognizable: professional communications headsets worn on heads with natural boom microphones, customer-contact workstation/screens with unreadable interface text, desk telephone or call-script papers. All human foreground staff Japanese adults. Natural proportions and coherent anatomy. Photographic concepts must be photographs; illustrative/sculptural concepts must follow their distinct direction.
Palette: mostly white, navy, cobalt blue and pale blue/teal, natural skin tones. The attached site's other brand colors are reference context, not output requirements. Keep bright edges that suit a white page, with no full dark rectangular background.
NO copied company logos, brands, slogans, named people, identity recreation, dates, certifications, customer quotes, salary/benefit promises, numerical claims, header/navigation, website CTA, browser chrome, watermarks or multiple concept thumbnails. No company-specific recruitment conditions. Preserve legibility, avoid cropped lettering or faces. Output exactly one finished opaque hero image, not a full page.

attached_images.role: Actual website screenshot; composition/type hierarchy reference

borrowed_visual_element: 白地に人物の切り抜き、斜めの色面、右寄せの大きなコピー。視線が対角線に流れる構成。

visual_inspection.headline: Exact approved Japanese headline complete/readable
visual_inspection.call_center: Two foreground adults wear natural boom-mic headsets; background call-center staff, CRM screens and desk telephone visible
visual_inspection.reference_derived_composition: Left photorealistic cutout-style pair, right large navy copy, white background with broad ascending pale-blue diagonal stripe
